data.one_liner: Retrieve physical display size, resolution, and PPI, and convert inches and mm to logical pixels.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that retrieves physical display metrics such as resolution, size in inches, diagonal, and PPI across multiple platforms. It provides a widget and BuildContext extensions to convert physical units like inches and millimeters into Flutter logical pixels.
use_when: You need physical display dimensions like inches or millimeters for accurate scaling or UI creation.
You need to convert physical measurements (inches, mm) directly into Flutter logical pixels.
avoid_when: You are targeting web platforms where physical dimensions cannot be accurately determined due to browser limitations.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and Web.
Provides convenient BuildContext extension methods for unit conversion.
Handles unknown or new devices via an onUnknownDisplay callback.
weaknesses: Physical dimensions and DPI cannot be accurately determined on the web platform due to browser restrictions.
Requires placing DisplayMetricsWidget above MaterialApp in the widget tree.
data.setup_notes: Add DisplayMetricsWidget above MaterialApp in your widget tree to enable DisplayMetrics.of(context) and BuildContext extensions.
